done_when: The logger template's fatal() writes a fatal-level line; the Playwright template sets testDir to its e2e folder; forge init copies the Node Dockerfile and .dockerignore only into Node repos; the Mac and Windows installers check docker info and print the step to start Docker Desktop when it isn't running; the guide names the Yarn 1 and Yarn 2+ update commands; command tests cover init on Node, Python and Go repos and the templates' contents for a new repo and one adopted on an earlier release

findings.body: The command labelled “Yarn 2+” does not work on Yarn 2: `yarn up -R '*'` requires Yarn 3 or later. New evidence beyond the coordinator’s ruling based on current documentation: [Yarn’s official changelog](https://github.com/yarnpkg/berry/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md#300) explicitly records `-R,--recursive` as a new option in 3.0.0. A client pinned to Yarn 2 therefore encounters an unsupported option instead of refreshing dependencies. This affects `src/forge/templates/skill.md` and both `.codex/skills/forge/SKILL.md` and `.claude/skills/forge/SKILL.md`. Distinguish Yarn 2 from Yarn 3+ and provide range-preserving instructions that work for each. The guide test at `tests/test_client_setup_matches_stack.py:63` currently requires the incompatible command, so it must be corrected alongside all three guides.
findings.title: Not done: The guide names the Yarn 1 and Yarn 2+ update commands

why: Real issues reviews raised and the coordinator skipped, still in Forge's client templates and setup (audit of dismissed findings, 2026-10-09): the backend logger template has no fatal(), the Playwright config has no testDir and collects Vitest files, forge init copies the Node Dockerfile and .dockerignore into Python and Go repos, the installers never say to start Docker Desktop, and the guide's dependency refresh names yarn upgrade, which Yarn 2+ lacks
